description: This file defines an interface for product repository operations, including methods for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting products in a data store.

classes.name: IProductRepository
classes.description: An interface abstracting product persistence operations such as CRUD actions.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Returns all products as an enumerable collection.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its identifier, or null if not found.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a new product and assigns it a unique identifier.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a product by id and returns true if deletion was successful.
